items.t: Archer Aviation (ACHR) Plans Insitu Deal That Could Recast Its Defense Story
items.sum: Archer Aviation (NYSE:ACHR) plans to acquire Boeing's defense drone subsidiary Insitu, expanding beyond its core urban air taxi focus. The deal would make Boeing the largest shareholder in Archer Aviation through a mix of equity and other consideration tied to Insitu.
